audit.why: 50.35% over 143 games is the dead-even split the chart already shows: Kennen owns the level 1-2 poke window and the late AOE-stun teamfight, Camille owns levels 3-5 and the isolated duel. Nothing in the stage split contradicts the number.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike called Slicing Maelstrom a channel. Riot's text describes a storm that strikes nearby enemies for a duration - it is not a channel, so there is nothing for your Hookshot to interrupt, and its 120s flat cooldown was never given.
audit.why: Riot: 'Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.' Cooldown 120s at every rank per champ-data/_kits/kennen.json - which is what makes 'wait it out' actionable.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text and whys[4] drop the channel wording and name the flat 120s so the bait-or-wait advice has a number attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mark of the Storm was described as chipping you 'on every auto' and as 'the mark his passive stacks on autos', in three places. Mark of the Storm is the stun-at-three-stacks passive; it does no damage and his basic attacks do not apply it. The mark that rides his attacks comes from Electrical Surge (W), which adds one every few attacks and is on-hit, so his damage scales with attack speed rather than raw AP. That on-hit line was missing entirely.
audit.why: Riot: Mark of the Storm - 'Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.' Electrical Surge - 'Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks.' _missing-interactions.json flags onhit-itemization for this pairing.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, early and whys[0] now credit Electrical Surge (W, 13s) for the on-hit mark and describe Mark of the Storm as the three-stack stun it is. Camille's Hookshot 'stun' becomes a knock-up throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Wait out his Lightning Rush' carried no number, and neither did the shuriken window.
audit.why: Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s and Thundering Shuriken 7/6.25/5.5/4.75/4s - the E is the long one, so it is the cooldown your all-in is keyed to, not the Q.
audit.corrected: early and wants.you[0] now key the commit to Lightning Rush's 10s rank-1 window.

notes: Mark of the Storm being described as auto-attack chip damage is a real mechanical error - it does no damage at all, it is the three-stack stun, and only Electrical Surge puts marks on his attacks. That misreading also hid the thing that actually matters for your build: his damage is on-hit and attack-speed-scaled, so armour reads the trade wrong. The '~13 armor Kennen' figure in spikes[3].text and whys[5] is a raw stat I could not verify from the kit files, so I left both strings alone. Camille's Hookshot was called a stun throughout this file; Riot's text says it knocks up. Same templated error is in every Camille matchup.
